svg.title: CommentThreadFeat reused by two consumer features
svg.desc: PostDetailFeat and PhotoDetailFeat both render CommentThreadFeat with their own subjectId. CommentThreadFeat provides CommentsState, injects CurrentUser, owns editingId signal. It wires the same dumb children CommentEditorUi and CommentUi as the worked example.
